P.name: Mana Barrier
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, when damaged to {{as|{{sti|health|30% '''maximum''' health}}}}, '''Blitzcrank''' generates a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{sti|mana|{{as|35% of '''maximum''' mana}}}}, lasting for up to 10 seconds.
P.static: {{tt|90|Starts immediately when the shield is gained}}

P.name: Mana Barrier 2
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, when damaged to {{as|{{sti|health|30% '''maximum''' health}}}}, '''Blitzcrank''' generates a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{sti|mana|{{as|35% of '''maximum''' mana}}}}, lasting for up to 10 seconds.
P.static: {{tt|90|Starts immediately when the shield is gained}}

Q.name: Rocket Grab
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Blitzcrank''' fires their right hand in the target direction that catches the first enemy hit, dealing them {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.65 seconds}}, and {{tip|airborne|pulling}} them towards '''Blitzcrank''', during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}.
Q.description2: '''''Blitzcrank''' is {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while Rocket Grab is in flight and for {{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Estimated}} seconds after it hits an enemy.''

W.name: Overdrive
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Blitzcrank''' shifts into overdrive, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 5 seconds and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays to 10% over the first {{fd|2.9}} seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|30 to 70}}%}}{{st|Initial Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|60 to 80}}%}}
W.description2: When ''Overdrive'' ends, '''Blitzcrank''' is {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 30% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

E.name: Power Fist
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Blitzcrank''' empowers their next {{tip|basic attack}} within 5 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, deal {{as|100% AD}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knock up}} the target for 1 second. This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
E.description3: ''Power Fist {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Blitzcrank's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Static Field
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While ''Static Field'' is not on cooldown, '''Blitzcrank's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} apply a {{tip|stack}} to the target {{tip|on-hit}}. While the target is afflicted, one stack is consumed every 1 second to strike them with lightning, dealing {{as|magic damage}} each time.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Blitzcrank''' detonates a static field that destroys the damage-mitigating {{tip|shield|shields}} of all nearby enemies, excluding the shields of {{tip|monsters}}, and then deals them {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|silence|silences}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
